name: Sultry Secrets
source: A young couple moves to the sunny Port of Ventura, hoping to start a new life. But the sun, the sea and new acquaintances are fraught with unexpected twists. Will their love be able to withstand the test of passion, temptation and the dark secrets that this paradise hides? You will find a story about trust and betrayal, about the limits of desire and how easy it is to lose yourself trying to please others.
translation: 一对年轻情侣搬到了阳光明媚的文图拉港，期盼在此开启崭新的生活。然而灿烂阳光、蔚蓝大海与新结识的朋友背后，却潜藏着意想不到的波折。面对炽热激情、重重诱惑以及这座人间天堂掩藏的黑暗秘密，他们的爱情能否经受住考验？你将见证一个关于信任与背叛、欲望边界，以及人在一味迎合他人时究竟有多容易迷失自我的故事。
